Level 1: Basic / Descriptive: High-level list of challenges, opportunities, and expected benefits.
Level 2: Defined / Logical: Logical mapping of how specific features address challenges and drive value.
Level 3: Applied / Behavioral: Worked examples, case studies, or behavioral narratives showing value realization.
Level 4: Comprehensive / Automated: Ready-to-use templates for capturing value, or automated dashboards tracking outcomes.

Level 1: Basic / Descriptive: Basic identification of security risks, compliance needs, and legal liabilities.
Level 2: Defined / Logical: Detailed risk assessment matrices and documented compliance mappings.
Level 3: Applied / Behavioral: Scenario-based guides detailing how users should behave to mitigate specific risks.
Level 4: Comprehensive / Automated: Automated compliance auditing tools, security posture checks, and full policy templates.

Level 1: Basic / Descriptive: Simple list of Personas by name or title.
Level 2: Defined / Logical: Detailed Persona profiles detailing specific needs, interests, and expected value.
Level 3: Applied / Behavioral: Empathy maps and behavioral journey mappings from the perspective of each Persona.
Level 4: Comprehensive / Automated: Interactive stakeholder alignment templates or dynamic persona-specific onboarding materials.
